verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented bulk or batch operation that acts on many workspace items (sources, destinations, transformations, tracking plans) at once, whether through the UI, the MCP server or the APIs. The management APIs and MCP tools are described only as per-feature management primitives, which are developer building blocks rather than a bulk capability. Fan-out of events to many destinations and warehouse syncs are data-pipeline behaviors, not bulk operations on items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
